messages:
Vera Lopez: Opening a small docs PR to tidy the "Getting Started" quickstart. Aim: CLI-first auth, short env var & PowerShell examples, concise single-line deploys (Docker + k8s demo), fix a bad /guides link, and add a model alias migration note (helium-v1 -> helium). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5172
Caleb Ortiz: Love CLI-first. For Windows please add PowerShell env example: `$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = "<KEY>"` so folks on Windows aren't blocked.
Vera Lopez: Will do. Top of page will show `redwood login --api-key <KEY>`; below an "Advanced (CI & env)" collapsible with `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` and the PowerShell line.
Maya (Docs): Also show a one-line curl auth check for troubleshooting: `curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` and mention clock skew as a common cause of 401s.
Vera Lopez: Added the curl check and a short token-scope note (user vs org keys). Also included a tiny sed/perl pair to help repos migrate model aliases: `git grep -l "helium-v1" | xargs sed -i 's/helium-v1/helium/g'` and macOS-safe: `git grep -l "helium-v1" | xargs sed -i '' 's/helium-v1/helium/g'`.
Caleb Ortiz: For Docker base prefer `node:18-slim` (or `node:18-bullseye-slim` for enterprise). Also include an Alpine variant note.
Vera Lopez: Swapped primary Dockerfile to `node:18-bullseye-slim` and appended an Alpine example. Reduced deploy steps to three bullets and labeled k8s/Docker lines as "DEMO ONLY".
ci-bot: Preview build queued for PR 5172 (preview URL when ready).
Maya (Docs): One wording nit: the quickstart currently said "no rate limits" in an earlier draft. Please change to "soft limits on free tier; see pricing" and link to pricing.
Vera Lopez: Fixed language and added pricing link. Also showed SDK init with EU region example: `RedwoodClient(region="eu-west-1")`.
ci-bot: Preview build passed for PR 5172 2705 (staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/getting-started/preview)
Caleb Ortiz: Reviewed and approved. Thanks for keeping it compact, should reduce confusion for new signups.
Vera Lopez: Merging during the docs deploy window. Will follow up if any post-merge issues. :shipit:
